newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Feb tax collection up 8.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Feb tax collection up 8.9 pct.

text.p: Argentina's February tax collection was $3.64 billion, 8.9 percent more than in February 1996, the Economy Ministry said Monday.
But compared with January 1997's $4.36 billion, collection dropped by 16.4 percent, the ministry said in its monthly tax report.
Total value added tax collected reached $2.04 billion, a 4.3 percent increase over February last year.
Tax revenue was slightly lower than the average forecast by analysts in a Reuters poll, who predicted collection would reach $3.78 billion.
